import os,tempfile,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
binary=Path(os.environ['SWARM_PROFILE_LEVEL_BINARY']).resolve()
if not binary.is_file():raise ValueError('profile-level-binary-missing')
base=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='profile-level-',dir='.cache')).resolve()
subprocess.run(['python3','tests/rust_launch_profile_level.py','--binary',str(binary),'--output',str(base/'run')],check=True)
print('REPLAY_EVIDENCE '+str(base),flush=True)
